All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class VkOffset3D extends Struct<VkOffset3D> implements NativeResource
struct VkOffset3D {
    int32_t x;
    int32_t y;
    int32_t z;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • VkOffset3D

      public VkOffset3D(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a VkOffset3D instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
